2609.01493.title: Rethinking Learnability in Offline Data-driven Optimization
2609.01493.paper_summary: Black-Box Optimization (BBO) has found broad applications, but evolutionary algorithms and Bayesian optimization face efficiency challenges as real-world BBO problems grow increasingly complex. Data-driven optimization improves the efficiency of BBO algorithms by learning from data. Offline data-driven optimization seeks high-quality solutions using only a fixed set of previous evaluations, attracting substantial attention because it requires no additional online evaluations. Many offline optimization methods have been proposed, but a fundamental question remains unanswered: what learnability is sufficient for offline optimization? Prior theoretical studies show that Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learnability is insufficient, as the optimal region may remain poorly learned even when most regions are well learned. In this paper, we propose algorithm-dependent learnability, which requires accuracy only on the optimizer's trajectory. We prove that its value-query form is sufficient for representative discrete settings, including greedy and local search for submodular maximization, while its first-order analogue is sufficient for projected gradient descent on convex minimization. Motivated by this notion, we formalize a trajectory-learning framework comprising trajectory construction, trajectory modeling, and candidate generation, and analyze existing trajectory-based methods under it. We further propose Uncertainty-aware Gradient-guided Trajectory Learning (UGTL), which constructs locally coherent improvement trajectories reflecting plausible search paths, models them with conditional diffusion, and selects a diverse candidate set. On five Design-Bench tasks, UGTL achieves the best aggregate mean rank, $3.1/25$, among 25 methods. Controlled trajectory analyses and cross-architecture replacements confirm that our trajectory construction plays a significant role in the improvement.
2609.01493.paper_summary_zh: 黑箱優化（BBO）已廣泛應用，但隨著現實世界的 BBO 問題變得越來越複雜，進化算法和貝葉斯優化面臨效率挑戰。<lb/>數據驅動的優化通過從數據中學習來提高 BBO 算法的效率。<lb/>離線數據驅動的優化僅使用固定的先前評估集尋求高質量解決方案，因為它不需要額外的在線評估而受到廣泛關注。<lb/>許多離線優化方法已被提出，但一個根本性問題仍未解答：對於離線優化，什麼樣的可學習性是足夠的？<lb/>先前的理論研究表明，可能近似正確（PAC）可學習性是不足的，因為即使大多數區域被很好地學習，最佳區域仍可能學習不佳。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了算法依賴的可學習性，這要求僅在優化器的軌跡上達到準確性。<lb/>我們證明其值查詢形式對於代表性的離散設置是足夠的，包括子模最大化的貪婪和局部搜索，而其一階類比對於凸最小化的投影梯度下降是足夠的。<lb/>受到這一概念的啟發，我們正式化了一個軌跡學習框架，包括軌跡構建、軌跡建模和候選生成，並在此框架下分析現有的基於軌跡的方法。<lb/>我們進一步提出了不確定性感知的梯度引導軌跡學習（UGTL），該方法構建反映合理搜索路徑的局部一致改進軌跡，並使用條件擴散對其進行建模，選擇多樣的候選集。<lb/>在五個 Design-Bench 任務中，UGTL 在 25 種方法中實現了最佳的總體平均排名 $3.1/25$。<lb/>控制的軌跡分析和跨架構替換確認我們的軌跡構建在改進中起著重要作用。
